# NLC Builds

> Licensed design-build remodeling contractor serving the Philadelphia region: decks, porches, kitchens, baths, basements, additions, windows and doors. Formerly Next Level Construct. Based in Essington, PA. Phone (215) 980-0195.

Licenses: PA HIC #PA201433 (Next Level Construct, L.L.C.) · DE #2026700487 · NJ HIC #13VH14325000 (Next Level Carpentry LLC).

We handle permits and historic-commission (HARB/HPC) approvals in every town we serve.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://nlcbuilds.com/): services, work, reviews, free quote
- [Service areas](https://nlcbuilds.com/areas/): all towns served
- [Services](https://nlcbuilds.com/services/): everything we build

## Services
- [Decks & Porches](https://nlcbuilds.com/services/decks-porches/): Custom decks, porch rebuilds, composite decking and railings from a licensed PA, NJ & DE contractor. Permits and historic reviews handled for you.
- [Windows & Doors](https://nlcbuilds.com/services/windows-doors/): Replacement windows, entry doors, sliding patio doors and storm doors, measured, set square and sealed. Licensed in PA, NJ & DE, historic-district approvals handled.
- [Basement Finishing](https://nlcbuilds.com/services/basements/): Basement finishing from framing and insulation to drywall, egress windows and trim. Permitted and inspected. Licensed in PA, NJ and Delaware.
- [Kitchen Remodels](https://nlcbuilds.com/services/kitchens/): Kitchen remodels with cabinetry, counters, tile and trim, planned and built by a licensed PA, NJ and DE contractor. Clear written estimates.
- [Bathroom Remodels](https://nlcbuilds.com/services/bathrooms/): Bathroom remodels with proper waterproofing, tile, vanities and fixtures from a licensed PA, NJ and DE contractor. Built to last.
- [Additions & Dormers](https://nlcbuilds.com/services/additions/): Home additions, dormers and sunrooms designed and built by a licensed PA, NJ and DE contractor. Zoning, historic review and permits handled.
